pages.text: Seven trinkets forged from akaishi power (worn in the trinket slots), each a "cheat code":$(li)Hunting Ring: combat buffs$(li)Fortune Bracelet: boosted harvest$(li)Flame Necklace: fire resistance$(li)Antidote Bracelet: neutralizes poison$(li)Blast Charm: reduced explosion damage$(li)Wither Charm: wards off withering$(li)Saturation Charm: eating buffs$(br2)Put them all on and you're a walking fortress.
